environment: Disposable Linux ARM64 VM, 1 CPU and 2 GiB RAM; local bare Git remote
method: The native checkpoint CLI captured a signed synthetic repository. The native archive candidate verified its contract and closure, staged blocks and manifest, invoked real Git to push to a local bare remote, fetched independently, checked the tree, fsck and signed checkpoint closure, and reported stored.
controls: A fake gh program reporting private=false or additional output was refused before work creation; an incorrect epoch and an existing work directory were refused. A non-fast-forward push failure followed by readback of the same tree returned unacknowledged success; a conflicting tree returned unknown-or-conflict.
limits: GitHub privacy responses were produced by a test-only stub and the GitHub URL was deliberately rewritten to the local bare remote using a test-only Git config. This did not test real GitHub, network loss after a successful push, credentials or secret isolation. The test compiler is byte-patched, not a released or self-built artifact. The complete resident/cron integration, Darwin, child lifecycle and fleet governor remain unqualified.
